{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Confections|Confections]] | [[Cookbook:Fudge|Fudge]]

The delicious treat from heaven made easy for you to make at home.

== Ingredients ==
*3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:White sugar|white granulated sugar]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Corn Syrup|corn syrup]]
*1¼ cups [[Cookbook:Condensed milk|condensed milk]]
*¼ cup of [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

== Procedure ==
#Line a deep tray with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|grease-proof paper]].
#Combine the white sugar, syrup, condensed milk and butter together in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
#Cook on a medium level of heat on the stove and bring to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Stirring constantly (so it doesn’t burn), cook for 5 minutes after it reaches boiling point.
#Remove the fudge from the heat and beat in the vanilla extract.
#Pour the fudge into the tray and leave to cool until set.
#Cut fudge into pieces.
#Enjoy!
